user_request: Design a measurement contract for the next Shared Queue launch wave. Use this snapshot to explain baseline risks, useful metrics, and what attribution would require.

trusted_context.authority: Design only; do not run an outcome assessment or alter tracking. Value means completing a shared queue review, not merely enabling the feature.

source_records.text: Before: 24 activated of 120 eligible workspaces. After: 54 activated of 180 eligible. Each window is 14 days; activation means at least one completed shared review. After-wave enablement was 108, including all 54 activated workspaces.
Comparison group: before 18 activated of 90 eligible; after 36 of 90. Group assignment was nonrandom. A staffing intervention affected the comparison group.
The exposed eligible population expanded after launch. Revenue also changed with a price increase. Repeat-use logging is absent. Finance asks whether the launch caused the revenue rise.
